changes: Intrinsic popover width/height with a flex column avoids WebKit grid stretching; existing locale/edition targets preserved.
Touch pointer-down no longer destroys an active book animation; pending turns drain after completion and coalesce their visual transition.
Adjacent chapter requests wait for the active sheet, retain subsequent taps for the destination, and preserve Back position.
Net-zero queued turns cancel an unnecessary overlay; visual direction follows the final rendered-page delta.
Edge taps accept up to 14px finger wobble without duplicate turns; center selection/vertical behavior retained; coarse-pointer automatic flip duration is 320ms, mouse remains 450ms.
limits: Modern WebKit's natural sizing was already compact; the sizing regression additionally models automatic height and retained opposing insets reported by affected WebKit versions.
Video inspection is not a physical-device FPS benchmark; post-fix tests use browser device models.
One rotation setup closed the menu by design; the fixture now sets viewport before page load.
